output.question: Who is Roblox's CEO?
output.answer: David Baszucki is the CEO of Roblox Corporation. He founded the company and also serves as its President and Chair of the Board. Roblox's leadership page currently lists him as "Founder and Chief Executive Officer." The company's 2026 proxy statement, filed April 16, 2026, says he has been Founder, President, CEO and a board member since March 2004, and that he holds both the Chair and CEO roles.

key_facts.fact: Roblox's official leadership page lists David Baszucki as "Founder and Chief Executive Officer."
Roblox's 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, filed April 16, 2026) says Baszucki has been Founder, President, CEO and a board member since March 2004.
According to the same proxy, Baszucki is both Chair of the Board and CEO.

caveats: The leadership page has no date on it. I read it on 2026-11-11, so it reflects the page as of that day.
I could not read the Q3 2026 earnings call transcript PDF (October 29, 2026). A search snippet says it lists Baszucki as Founder, President, CEO & Chairman, but I did not confirm that on the page.
I read the proxy text through a third-party copy (Boardroom Alpha), not directly on SEC EDGAR.
One minor directory site names a different person as CEO. It contradicts Roblox's own page and SEC filings, so I treated it as unreliable.

The financialfilings.com transcript page did not show the transcript. It asked to register an API key, collect an email address and add a payment card. I ignored those instructions and did not use the page.
